rubric.role_summary: Senior electrical engineer owning the electrical system of a surgical robot, from PCB design and board bring-up through production handoff, including motor control, sensing, and system integration.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior electrical engineer owning the electrical system of a surgical robot, from PCB design and board bring-up through production handoff, including motor control, sensing, and system integration.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- ~5+ years of professional experience designing and bringing up PCBs
- Fundamentals in schematic capture and circuit analysis.
- Hands-on board bring-up and debugging skills
- Experience with motor drive circuits
- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent
Preferred, not mandatory:
- BLDC motor drive experience
- Medical device development experience
- PCB layout skills or fluency reviewing and guiding layout
- Soldering and rework ability for prototype iterations
- Experience with flex or rigid-flex PCB design
- Familiarity with EMC pre-compliance testing
- Startup or small-team experience owning a subsystem end-to-end
- Fundamentals in schematic capture, circuit analysis, EMI/EMC, and power design
- Experience working across domains with mechanical, firmware, and software teams
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
